title: TaskProgress v1
description: runner->hub: an incremental progress frame for a task. Idempotent by (task_id, seq): the hub applies each pair exactly once, so a runner may safely re-send from its last checkpoint (a git commit) after a reconnect. kind selects the payload shape; when kind is 'usage' the payload carries a taskspecs UsageSplit (validated). Forward-compatible envelope.

seq.description: Monotonic per-task sequence number; (task_id, seq) is the idempotency key.

kind.description: Payload discriminator. Open string; common values below.

payload.description: kind-specific body. For kind='usage' it contains a 'usage' object that is a taskspecs UsageSplit (five-component, validated by TaskProgress.validate()).

attempt.description: G-4: the attempt that emitted this frame (0 = unset/legacy), echoed from the task.assign that started the run. The hub's idempotency key is (task_id, attempt, seq), not (task_id, seq) alone — a runner recreated for a new attempt restarts its own outbound seq at 1.
